summary: 10.0.41.02 Universal Zero-Flash Routing, Immediate Hash View Hydration, and Header/Tab State Parity Across All Screens
highlights: 1. Universal Zero-Flash Routing: Synchronous pre-paint route resolution in head guarantees that refreshing on any screen (Purchase, Bank, Sales, Quotations, Items, etc.) renders the target view from frame 0 with zero dashboard flash.
2. Synchronous Header & Tab Hydration: Pre-hydrates active module title, breadcrumb hierarchy, and workspace tab bar before script execution.
3. Auth Screen Leak Prevention: Instant authentication guard hides all background ERP views and renders the Auth overlay exclusively when unauthenticated.
4. Clean Early Router Hand-off: Seamless transition between early layout styles and NavigationRouter without layout shifts or duplicated active view states.
